title: Art. 25 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter III - Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage, Article 25 — Stipulation on Limits
theme: Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage
content: A carrier may stipulate that the contract of carriage shall be subject to higher limits of liability than those provided for in this Convention or to no limits of liability whatsoever.
text: A carrier may stipulate that the contract of carriage shall be subject to higher limits of liability than those provided for in this Convention or to no limits of liability whatsoever.
